sources.snippet: This model is one of four architectures compared in a broader study, "Beyond BLEU: Evaluating Automated Metric Reliability for Bengali Paraphrase Generation" (GitHub repo), which benchmarks full fine-tuning vs. QLoRA and validates standard automated metrics (BLEU, ROUGE-L, BERTScore, PINC) against an LLM-as-a-judge.
